governance.attested_by: miso-49 keeper promotion, MISO temperature-dependent-derate keeper rerun 2026-07-09 (docs/handoffs/temp-derate-keeper-rerun-playbook-2026-07.md)
governance.note: miso-49 = the miso-48 keeper recipe (ST_GAS_INTERMEDIATE SRMC-floor re-ground) re-solved byte-identical at HEAD with ONE addition: temp_dependent_derate=True (src/market_sim/config/scenarios.py) -- the flat EIA-860 net-summer/_SUMMER_CLASS_DERATE capacity treatment replaced by a per-class curve in measured hourly zone dry-bulb temperature (src/market_sim/data/fleet.py generators_to_fleet_arrays). CC/CT: capacity-NEUTRAL reshape, rescaled so its Jun-Sep mean reproduces the existing net-summer capability -- heatwave hours fall below net-summer (the scarcity driver), cooler hours rise toward full rating. COAL/ST_GAS: pure additive hot-hour derate (no prior summer derate existed for these classes). Nuclear excluded; zones without weather coverage fall back to the flat derate; availability always clipped to [0,1]. ZERO fitted/free parameters: the four slopes (CT 0.0126/C, CC 0.0076/C, ST_GAS 0.0054/C, COAL 0.0040/C) and two reference temperatures (15 C GT/steam ISO rating point, 25 C coal condenser onset) are literature-cited physical constants (arXiv:2311.07001; CPUC R.21-10-002; docs/parameter-citations.md), not tuned to this run's residual -- verified by the rule-20 zero-forcing ablation twin (2026-07-09-miso-49-tempderate-ablation), which reproduces the same C3c tail hours (0/6/3), same C1/C2/C3/C7/C8 pattern, and fuel-mix TWh within <0.3% of the main run across all three years -- the temperature mechanism's effect does not depend on the commitment floors/bridges. Promoted on structure (rules 1/11): C3a mean LMP error narrows in 2024 (-4.7% -> +0.8% keeper-vs-probe delta at registration, now -1.0% DA-diagnostic / CAVEAT within commercial band) and 2025 (-10.7% -> -8.7%); C3c scarcity tail partially opens in 2024 (0h -> 6h vs DA actual 24h, 25% of the gap) and 2025 (0h -> 3h vs 38h, 8%); 2023 stays 0h (DA actual is only 1h, not a meaningful target). This is a genuine physical mechanism newly engaged, not a fit to price/volume: per rule 1, kept regardless of whether it moves every gate -- C1/C2 volumes are essentially unchanged from miso-48 (temp-derate reshapes thermal availability, not merit order), and C7/C8 confirm the floors/bridges are not pushed over budget by the reshape. Everything else in the miso-48 recipe (seam ladder, reliability drags, reserve co-opt, coal sigmoids, ST_GAS_INTERMEDIATE SRMC floor) is unchanged; sigmoids NOT re-fit (rule 23).
governance.validation_note: Reproducible via scripts/probes/_miso_tempderate_ab.py main (git HEAD at promotion; the miso-48 recipe read live from its own meta.json, with temp_dependent_derate=True added -- see the script for the full kwarg mapping). Rule-20 ablation twin: scripts/probes/_miso_tempderate_ab.py ablation, registered as 2026-07-09-miso-49-tempderate-ablation. ~13 GB peak on a 15 GiB box -- completed with a 16 GiB swapfile (no MALLOC_ARENA_MAX / thread-cap flags applied this session). RESULT vs miso-48 (same scorer, rubric v2.2): C1 all 14/16 (was 13/16) -- but the flipped row (2023 ST_GAS -8.16 -> -7.99 TWh) is a marginal edge-of-band move, not attributable to temp-derate structurally fixing anything; C2 2025 unchanged (gas -14.7%, coal +16.3%); C3a improves in every year; C3c partially opens in 2024/2025 as above; C5a CO2 PASS; C5b/C5c unchanged benchmark-basis mismatch (see exceptions below, carried from miso-48); C7/C8 PASS. No unit pinned to observed CEMS generation; no input rescaled to land model output on actuals; the four slopes are the literature values, not values tuned to this residual.

exceptions.magnitude: +1418.1% (model 2025 discharge vs EIA-930 battery-only actual; 2023 model 2.622 TWh, 2024 model 2.619 TWh -- both un-benchmarked, EIA-930 reports no PS breakout for these years)
exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (benchmark basis mismatch -- not a model miss)
exceptions.reason: Carried unchanged from miso-48: EIA-930 MISO reports NO pumped-storage series (the PS column is all-null in every scored year of the balance files); the battery-only actual excludes the 2,417 MW EIA-860 PS fleet (Ludington + Taum Sauk) the model correctly dispatches. temp_dependent_derate does not touch storage; the mismatch and its magnitude are essentially identical to miso-48's own ledgered exception. Full adjudication: results/calibration/FINDING-miso-c5b-storage-benchmark-2026-07.md.

exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (same basis mismatch as C5b)
exceptions.reason: The monthly shape compares model BAT+PS discharge against the battery-only EIA-930 series; the PS seasonal arbitrage shape dominates the model side and is absent from the actual. Rides the C5b scorer fix. Unchanged from miso-48 (r=0.477 there).

disclosures.note: MODEL MISS grounds for the NOT-YET determination, carried forward from miso-48 -- temp_dependent_derate is a capacity/availability mechanism and does not address any of these open root causes (merit-order CT_PEAKER position, coal-sigmoid offer level, missing scarcity/RDC price formation). These stay open structural issues, not accepted measured-input limitations.

entries.name: temp_dependent_derate
entries.lineage_solves: 1 (miso-49 promotion; single-mechanism addition to the frozen miso-48 recipe)
entries.source: literature-cited thermal-derate physics, not fit to this model's residual: CT 0.0126/C (mid of 0.5-0.9%/F frame-GT range; arXiv:2311.07001 0.0083/C, CPUC R.21-10-002 ~1%/C), CC 0.0076/C net (arXiv:2311.07001 net-CC ~0.75%/C), ST_GAS 0.0054/C (CPUC R.21-10-002), COAL 0.0040/C onset 25C/77F (arXiv:2311.07001 modest steam-coal summer deration). docs/parameter-citations.md.
entries.root_cause: physically identified (independent literature sources), not derived from this backcast's price/volume residual -- CC/CT reshape is explicitly capacity-neutral on the Jun-Sep mean by construction (rules 1, 9), so it cannot be a level-fit. Validated via the rule-20 zero-forcing ablation twin (2026-07-09-miso-49-tempderate-ablation): near-identical C3c/C1/C2 outcome with all commitment floors off confirms the mechanism's effect is not floor-forced.
